{"code":"local function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
  local hp = defender.hp
  local shield = defender.shield or 0
  local initial_hp = hp
  local absorbed, overkill, crits, resolved = 0, 0, 0, 0
  local element = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = skill.hits or 1
  local seed = skill.seed or 0
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = defender.guarding or false
  local true_damage = skill.true_damage or false
  local power = skill.power
  local matrix = {
    physical = {fire=100, water=100, nature=100, neutral=100, ghost=0},
    fire = {fire=50, water=50, nature=200, neutral=100, ghost=100},
    water = {fire=200, water=50, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100},
    nature = {fire=50, water=200, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100}
  }
  local m = matrix[element][defender.element]
  for k = 1, hits do
    if hp <= 0 then break end
    resolved = resolved + 1
    local p = math.max(10, power - 20 * (k - 1))
    local d = math.floor(attacker.atk * p / 100)
    local diff = math.max(-10, math.min(10, attacker.level - defender.level))
    d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3 * diff) / 100)
    local critical = ((seed + 17 * k) % 100) < (attacker.crit_chance or 0)
    if critical then
      crits = crits + 1
      d = math.floor(d * (attacker.crit_mult or 150) / 100)
    end
    local immune = false
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = attacker.pen_pct or 0
      if critical then pen = pen * 2 end
      pen = math.min(100, pen)
      local ea = math.max(0, math.floor(defender.armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - (attacker.pen_flat or 0))
      d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
      immune = (m == 0)
      d = math.floor(d * m / 100)
      local r = math.max(-50, math.min(80, resist[element] or 0))
      d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
    end
    if guarding then d = math.floor(d / 2) end
    if d < 1 and not immune then d = 1 end
    local a = math.min(shield, d)
    shield = shield - a
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and shield == 0 then loss = math.floor(loss * 125 / 100) end
    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      break
    else
      hp = hp - loss
    end
  end
  return {damage=initial_hp-hp, absorbed=absorbed, hp=hp, shield=shield, overkill=overkill, crits=crits, hits=resolved, killed=(hp == 0)}
end

end

return show(r1) .. ' ' .. show(r2)"}

  if type(name) ~= 'string' or not coreai_world_exists(name) then return 'none' end
  local p = coreai_world_pos(name)
  if not p then return 'none' end
  local towers = {}
  local dmin = math.huge
  for i = 1, 8 do
    local tower = 'Tower' .. i
    if coreai_world_exists(tower) then
      local q = coreai_world_pos(tower)
      if q then
        local dx, dz = p.x - q.x, p.z - q.z
        local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
        towers[#towers + 1] = {name = tower, distance = d}
        if d < dmin then dmin = d end
      end
    end
  end
  if #towers == 0 then return 'none' end
  for _, t in ipairs(towers) do
    if t.distance <= 1.01 * dmin then return t.name end
  end
  return 'none'
end)

  b = tonumber(b) or 0

    if d > 180 then d = 360 - d end
    return d
  end

{"code":"local function route(grid, teleporters)
  local rows = #grid
  local cols = #grid[1]
  local cells = rows * cols
  local total = cells * 4
  local tiles = {}
  local start, goal

  for r = 1, rows do
    for c = 1, cols do
      local cell = (r - 1) * cols + c
      local tile = string.sub(grid[r], c, c)
      tiles[cell] = tile
      if tile == 'S' then start = cell end
      if tile == 'G' then goal = cell end
    end
  end

  local tele_by_source = {}
  for i = 1, #teleporters do
    local t = teleporters[i]
    local source = (t.fr - 1) * cols + t.fc
    if not tele_by_source[source] then tele_by_source[source] = {} end
    table.insert(tele_by_source[source], t)
  end

  local dist, acts, done = {}, {}, {}
  for i = 1, total do dist[i] = math.huge; acts[i] = math.huge; done[i] = false end
  local initial = (start - 1) * 4 + 1
  dist[initial] = 0
  acts[initial] = 0

  local function enter(tile, mask, dr, dc, teleport)
    if tile == '#' then return nil end
    if tile == 'A' and mask % 2 == 0 then return nil end
    if tile == 'B' and math.floor(mask / 2) % 2 == 0 then return nil end
    if not teleport then
      if tile == '>' and dc ~= 1 then return nil end
      if tile == '<' and dc ~= -1 then return nil end
      if tile == '^' and dr ~= -1 then return nil end
      if tile == 'v' and dr ~= 1 then return nil end
    end
    if tile == 'a' then mask = mask - mask % 2 + 1 end
    if tile == 'b' and math.floor(mask / 2) % 2 == 0 then mask = mask + 2 end
    return mask
  end

  while true do
    local best = nil
    for s = 1, total do
      if not done[s] and dist[s] < math.huge and
         (best == nil or dist[s] < dist[best] or
          (dist[s] == dist[best] and acts[s] < acts[best])) then
        best = s
      end
    end
    if best == nil then return {cost = -1, actions = -1} end
    done[best] = true
    local cell = math.floor((best - 1) / 4) + 1
    local mask = (best - 1) % 4
    if cell == goal then return {cost = dist[best], actions = acts[best]} end
    local r = math.floor((cell - 1) / cols) + 1
    local c = (cell - 1) % cols + 1

    local function relax(dest, newmask, cost)
      local ns = (dest - 1) * 4 + newmask + 1
      local nc, na = dist[best] + cost, acts[best] + 1
      if nc < dist[ns] or (nc == dist[ns] and na < acts[ns]) then
        dist[ns], acts[ns] = nc, na
      end
    end

    local dirs = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}}
    for i = 1, 4 do
      local dr, dc = dirs[i][1], dirs[i][2]
      local nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
      if nr >= 1 and nr <= rows and nc >= 1 and nc <= cols then
        local dest = (nr - 1) * cols + nc
        local newmask = enter(tiles[dest], mask, dr, dc, false)
        if newmask ~= nil then
          local cost = tiles[dest] == '~' and 3 or 1
          relax(dest, newmask, cost)
        end
      end
    end

    local list = tele_by_source[cell]
    if list then
      for i = 1, #list do
        local t = list[i]
        local dest = (t.tr - 1) * cols + t.tc
        local newmask = enter(tiles[dest], mask, 0, 0, true)
        if newmask ~= nil then relax(dest, newmask, t.cost) end
      end
    end
  end
end
